build_s2t_transformer_model: build a speech-to-text transformer model with encoder and decoder using fairseq S2TTransformerModel
load_pretrained_s2t_model: load a pretrained speech-to-text transformer model from a checkpoint file using from_pretrained
configure_s2t_encoder: configure the S2TTransformerEncoder with convolutional subsampler and transformer layers for audio input
customize_s2t_architecture: customize the s2t_transformer architecture by setting encoder embed dim, layers, and attention heads
run_s2t_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the S2TTransformerModel with source tokens and previous output tokens
